Export Fire Hydrant Valve

Export Slanted Single-Outlet Hydrant Valve

A 45° slanted single-outlet fire hydrant valve for building riser and hydrant-cabinet systems, with a BS336 outlet coupling for international fire-hose connection. Bottom BSP inlet connects to the fire-water riser.

DN65 / 2½ in45° outlet1.6 MPa / 16 barBS336 coupling
Ask on WhatsAppView specifications

Outlet coupling is produced to the confirmed standard for the destination market (BS336, NH, Storz or other, per drawing).

Real product views

Front and three-quarter views

Photographs show the 45° slanted outlet, black handwheel, red ductile-iron body and outlet coupling. The visible physical GUANYA / 冠亚 product markings are retained; CHUANWEI FIRE identifies the website and export-sales presentation.
